traits.name: Resistant
traits.text: The roachling skirmisher has advantage on Constitution saving throws.

traits.name: Unlovely
traits.text: The skirmisher has disadvantage on Performance and Persuasion checks in interactions with nonroachlings.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The roachling lord makes two melee attacks or throws two darts.

actions.name: Begrimed Shortsword
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Begrimed Dart
actions.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) poison damage.
